title: Redis: an acks_late task longer than the visibility timeout reruns for ever with one process and prefetch 1, or with worker_disable_prefetch
status: documented: redis.rst:318-320 says "again, and again in a loop" for ETA, countdown and retry tasks; not in the tracker yet
where: celery issue 5935 (a 2023 comment there says "redelivered again and again in a loop"; nobody names the condition); kombu issue 337 (the renewal reply drafted, tracker reply-kombu-337-renew-scope)
thread: celery issue 5935, or the renewal reply on kombu issue 337 (the lead decides)
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, a real prefork worker -c 1 on Redis 7, visibility_timeout 2 s, sweep every second, a 5 s acks_late task, nothing injected, 40 s watched: prefetch multiplier 1: 8 runs, one every 5 s, still queued at the end; worker_disable_prefetch (multiplier 4): 8 runs, the same; multiplier 2: 3 runs (ceil(5 / 2)), then done; multiplier 1 with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks: 1 run and 1 skip; a 1 s task: 1 run.
